correctness.rationale: All four survival distributions were derived from the exact absorbing SI generator and independently checked against the full fifteen-state vertex-set generator: 15 Taylor derivatives for each allocation and admissible spectral multiplicities identify exponential-polynomial expressions by constant-coefficient ODE uniqueness. Strict all-time mixed-inferiority follows from positive factorizations and -log x >= 1-x, and one unique switch follows from the explicitly strictly concave polynomial R with endpoint signs. Exact mean integrals agree. The checker passed 89 exact assertions. Finite checks alone are not asserted to prove the continuous-time inequalities.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact allocation, time horizon, random infection mechanism and conclusion against primary SI, sensor-placement, fixed-horizon Markov, simulation and mean-delay literature, related mathematical claims, and published research-record hits. The nearest general Markovian framework supplies a computation scheme but not the exact strict crossing and complete optimization classification. Novelty is provisional, not a certification.
residual_risks: The 2007 outbreak-detection report has an evidenced month but not a verified public release day; the first dated primary-source release used here is the 2015-11-24 arXiv version, with 2007 work included as supporting background.

General finite-state hitting-time optimization can reproduce this four-type calculation with additional work; independent historical review could identify an already published exact comparison or table.
Some cited works have unexamined supplements, and the 2020 thesis host did not provide a usable screenshot although sections were read from parsed text.
Search engine and research-record coverage cannot establish uniqueness or absolute novelty.

value.rationale: A natural seven-node nonstar complete bipartite network and a fixed budget of three monitors yield a complete phase diagram revealing a genuinely counterintuitive late-deadline reversal of an always-higher-degree rule, while mean-delay optimization remains opposite. The strict exclusion of all mixed placements and unique exact polynomial threshold are structural results rather than a single numerical example. No unrealistic practical policy significance or general-network claim is made.
